question: What alternative rosary grants all accomplishments when the conch substitute is unavailable?
premises: The conch substitute may be absent.
A crystal rosary is prescribed in that case.
The crystal rosary grants all accomplishments.
inference: In the absence of the conch rosary, a crystal rosary that grants all accomplishments should be used.
plain_english: O goddess worshipped by heroes, in its absence a crystal one gives all accomplishments.
